average-value-rectangle.alt: The parabola f(x) = 6x − x² on 0 ≤ x ≤ 6 with the area under it shaded in crimson, 36 square units. A dashed blue rectangle of width 6 and height 6 has the same area, so the average value of f on [0, 6] is 6. The curve meets the line y = 6 at x = 3 − √3 and x = 3 + √3, marked with blue points.
